hook: Perform This 16-Second Morning Routine To Get Thick, Hard Erections Whenever You Want... No Matter Your Age
claim: NeuroTest is a men's testosterone and libido capsule built around LJ100, a patented tongkat ali extract, with mucuna, ashwagandha and krachaidum (black ginger).
ing_note: Unlike most products in this category, NeuroTest names a branded, studied extract (LJ100 tongkat ali) and cites the trials. Amounts per capsule aren't given in text.
use: Two capsules each morning on an empty stomach, according to the website.
checks: Tongkat ali (including LJ100) raised testosterone and improved sexual-function scores in several small trials, mainly in men with low testosterone.
Ashwagandha has small trials showing modest testosterone increases in stressed men.
Mucuna contains L-dopa, a powerful compound that interacts with many medicines; the fertility study cited was in infertile men.
'Hard erections whenever you want, no matter your age' overstates what these herbs achieve; prescription treatments are far more effective.
pros: Uses a branded, studied tongkat ali extract
verdict: NeuroTest is better grounded than most male-enhancement products because tongkat ali and ashwagandha have some human evidence. Expect modest effects at best. Erection problems can signal heart disease or diabetes, so see a doctor; if you take antidepressants, blood pressure or Parkinson's medicine, avoid mucuna-containing products unless your doctor approves.
